content.text: {"core": "Breakthrough collapses a structure whose load-bearing assumption has failed. Seated in its own position, the collapse turns on itself: the faculty that breaks false structures breaks its own accumulated framework, clearing the apparatus that names what counts as sound. Balanced, it drops only the member already carrying nothing, and the standing frame carries clean. What remains holds because it was tested to failure and did not fail.", "sheetLine": "It breaks its own scaffolding, and only what truly bears weight is left standing."}
